task_instruction: 示例（非正式测试案例）：围绕「图神经网络在逆合成反应预测中的表示学习、模板无关方法与低数据泛化」这批 9 条题录写一份带引用的文献综述草稿：先按标准筛选、主题从文献里归纳、证据逐条回链到原文整句、冲突并列、空白落到具体证据缺口。

output_contract.screening: 纳排标准与逐条筛选记录（纳入/排除 + criterion_id + 理由码）、去重记录
output_contract.topics: 主题树：主题/子问题/支撑文献/边界；未归类文献单列
output_contract.outline: 大纲：分节标题、每节计划引用的 evidence_id、节的性质（方法/主题/冲突/空白）
output_contract.evidence_table: 证据表：evidence_id / 文献标识 / 原文整句 / 定位 / 支撑主题 / 强度
output_contract.draft: 分节草稿：每句由原文整句 + [E###] 组成，含证据强度分级与自检（无证据句清单）
output_contract.evidence_map: 标准版本、主题术语集、证据↔主题映射、草稿↔证据映射、冲突与产物自检
output_contract.状态说明: 完成/部分完成、被排除文献、未归类、无证据主题、产物生成情况、不确定性

research_question: 图神经网络在逆合成反应预测中如何表示反应中心，模板无关方法与低数据条件下的泛化表现如何，评测口径是否可比？

records.title: Retrosynthesis Prediction with Graph Neural Networks and Message Passing
records.abstract: We present a graph neural network with a learned reaction centre representation for single-step retrosynthesis. Message passing over the molecular graph yields reaction centre candidates and reaches 52.3% top-1 accuracy on USPTO-50k.
records.venue: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling

records.title: Retrosynthesis Prediction with Graph Neural Networks and Message Passing
records.abstract: Preprint of the same graph neural network retrosynthesis study with the learned reaction centre representation.

records.title: Template-free retrosynthesis via graph attention
records.abstract: A template-free model reaches 48.1% top-1 accuracy on USPTO-50k and removes template construction entirely, while template-based baselines remain competitive in low data settings.

records.title: Low-data retrosynthesis: how much training data do we need
records.abstract: Under low data conditions (under 500 training reactions) top-1 accuracy drops by 12 percentage points, and the representation learned on the reaction centre generalizes poorly across reaction classes.

records.title: Benchmarking graph neural networks for reaction yield prediction
records.abstract: A benchmark with three dataset splits shows that reported top-1 accuracy differences are largely explained by split choice rather than architecture.

records.title: Re-examining single-step retrosynthesis benchmarks
records.abstract: We reproduce the message passing model on USPTO-50k and obtain 49.0% top-1 accuracy instead of 52.3%, which indicates evaluation leakage between splits.

records.title: Multi-step route planning with learned heuristics
records.abstract: Multi-step route planning is evaluated by route success rate rather than top-1 accuracy, so single-step benchmark numbers are not directly comparable.

records.title: Deep learning for retrosynthesis: a survey
records.abstract: A survey covering template-based and template-free retrosynthesis methods and their evaluation practice.

records.title: Catalytic C-H activation with earth-abundant metals
records.abstract: An experimental study on catalytic C-H activation with no computational retrosynthesis modelling.
